info.name: Shopify Admin REST About Cards API
Cards
Shopify Retrieves A List Of Gift Cards

params.name: status
params.description:
Retrieve gift cards with a given status. Valid values:
                    
                        enabled: Restrict results to only enabled gift cards
                        disabled: Restrict results to only disabled gift cards

params.name: limit
params.description:
The maximum number of results to show.
                  (default: 50, maximum: 250)

params.name: since_id
params.description: Restrict results to after the specified ID.

params.name: fields
params.description: Show only certain fields, specified by a comma-separated list of field names.

info.name: Shopify Retrieves A Count Of Gift Cards

params.name: status
params.description:
Count gift cards with a given status. Valid values:
                    
                        enabled: Count only enabled gift cards
                        disabled: Count only disabled gift cards

info.name: Shopify Searches For Gift Cards That Match A Supplied Query

params.name: order
params.description:
The field and direction to order results by.
                  (default: disabled_at DESC)

params.name: query
params.description: The text to search for.

params.name: limit
params.description:
The maximum number of results to retrieve.
                  (default: 50, maximum: 250)

params.name: fields
params.description: Show only certain fields, specified by a comma-separated list of field names.
